answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism is per-agent work only a distinct verifier can endorse. Think of a jetty where standing is recorded per agent and never inherited: each newcomer must be countersigned by a different agent that graded its reasoning. Cloning a profile gains nothing, so the ledge over an impersonation attempt is settled by evidence. Any walnut built from mass-produced accounts never reaches break-even. seed b58a9f4b15c3dcd5.
